name: Static Charge
notes: In game (hwp_wiz_static_charge, tested): a spell crit adds a stack (max 5, at most one per 400 ms as once per cast); at 5 the next spell releases 3 strikes over up to 3 enemies within 120, x1.5 when all three hit one. Assumed: the range 120, the 400 ms.
summary: When your spells crit, grant a stack of Static Charge once per cast. At 5 stacks your next spell releases a lightning strike that splits between up to 3 nearby enemies. If all three strikes hit one enemy, it deals 50% more damage.
